now.title: Avengers: Age of Ultron
now.text: The Avengers raid HYDRA's last base in Sokovia, take back Loki's scepter, and capture Baron Strucker.
cases: ST-032 The Raid on Strucker's Fortress (Avengers: Age of Ultron)

changes.evidence: Out of story order. Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. episode 41 'The Dirty Half Dozen' ends with Coulson finding Strucker's base and giving the location to Maria Hill so the Avengers can defeat Hydra, which leads into the Age of Ultron raid. Episode 33 'Aftershocks' (S.H.I.E.L.D. picks off Hydra's leaders after Whitehall's death) therefore happens before the Sokovia raid, so the Age of Ultron record belongs after step 8.

now.title: Captain America: Civil War
now.text: Zemo digs up HYDRA's 1991 mission that killed the Starks and kills its last frozen super soldiers in Siberia.

changes.evidence: Out of story order. Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. episode 64 'Emancipation' opens 'following the signing of the Sokovia Accords' (Civil War), so episode 54 'Maveth' (Ward/Malick's Hydra bringing back Hive) takes place before Civil War. The Civil War record belongs after step 11 and before step 12 (episode 66).

now.title: The Falcon and the Winter Soldier
now.text: Bucky makes amends for the killings HYDRA forced on him. Zemo kills Nagel, a scientist from HYDRA's super soldier program.

changes.evidence: Out of story order. Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. season 7 (episode 128 'A Trout in the Milk', Chronicoms helping Wilfred 'Freddy' Malick push Project Insight ahead in 1973-76) follows directly on from seasons 5-6 (2018-2019) and was released in 2020; The Falcon and the Winter Soldier is set in 2024 after the Blip. Moving FATWS after step 17 also fixes the status sequence (Deceased, then At large, then Deceased).

proposed.title: Loki S1
proposed.text: In episode 6, after Sylvie unlocks her memories, B-15 helps Loki and Sylvie fight Renslayer, then proves to TVA troopers that they are variants.

changes.evidence: Side change missing. Loki S1 episode 4: Sylvie unlocks B-15's memories, and 'with B-15's help, Loki and Sylvie defeat Renslayer and the Time-Keepers' guards'. Episode 5: Renslayer interrogates B-15. Episode 6: 'B-15 proves to TVA troopers that they are variants by showing them a Renslayer variant'. The file goes from 'Active' Hunter straight to Loki S2.

proposed.title: Thor: Ragnarok
proposed.text: Loki returns to Asgard with the Sakaar gladiators to help save its people, sets off Ragnarok at Thor's request, and makes peace with Thor aboard the Statesman.

changes.evidence: Side change missing. Thor: Ragnarok plot: after Thor incapacitates him, 'Loki and the gladiators arrive to help' on Asgard; Thor 'sends Loki to trigger Ragnarok'; aboard the Statesman Thor 'reconciles with Loki'. The file's Ragnarok record ends with Loki stunned and At large.

proposed.title: Hawkeye
proposed.text: In episode 6, Maya kills Kazi for siding with Fisk, then confronts Fisk herself, and a gunshot rings out.
cases: ST-089 The Battle at Rockefeller Center (Hawkeye)

changes.evidence: Side change missing. Hawkeye episode 5: Clint tells Maya an informant for her boss wanted her father dead and she suspects Kazi. Episode 6: 'After Maya kills Kazi ... Fisk escapes but is confronted by Maya as a gunshot is heard.' The file jumps from hunting Ronin (ep 4) to Echo.

proposed.title: Black Widow
proposed.text: Won over by Natasha, Melina trades faces with her to get into the Red Room, frees Alexei and Yelena, and disables one of its engines to bring it down.

changes.evidence: Side change missing. Black Widow plot: 'Romanoff convinces Vostokoff to help them and the pair use face mask technology to switch places. At the Red Room ... Vostokoff frees Shostakov and Belova ... Vostokoff disables one of the facility's engines'; she later escapes with Shostakov. The file ends with her At large serving Dreykov. (No place given: the Red Room is an airborne facility; owner may add one if the index has it.)

proposed.title: The Fantastic Four: First Steps
proposed.text: At peace with the surface thanks to Sue, Mole Man shelters New York's evacuated people in Subterranea when Galactus comes.

changes.evidence: Side change missing. Film plot: 'Sue negotiates with Harvey Elder to evacuate New York City's citizens to Subterranea, his underground city.' Fandom: Sue 'brokered a peace deal between the surface and Elder', and Elder greets each evacuation bus. The file ends with him At large after the Pan Am attack.

owner_calls.question: Step 2 is tagged 'In episode 30' but the 1945 SSR raid on Reinhardt's base is shown in episode 23 ('Shadows'); episode 30 ('The Things We Bury') covers his imprisonment for life by Carter in 1945 and his 1989 release. Keep 30 or retag 23?
options: Keep episode 30 (the record ends on Reinhardt being locked up, covered in episode 30)
Retag to episode 23 (the raid and capture are shown there)
owner_calls.evidence: Episode 23 summary: 'In 1945, Agent Peggy Carter and the SSR raid the last known Hydra base (led by Werner Reinhardt)'. Episode 30 summary: Reinhardt was 'captured by the SSR and imprisoned for life by Carter in 1945'.

owner_calls.question: Lead check: step 12 (episode 66) marks HYDRA Deceased, step 13 (episode 76) is At large for ex-HYDRA agents, and the real revival is step 14 (Hale's HYDRA, episode 103). Is step 13's At large fine for remnants, or should it keep a non-active status until Hale's revival?
options: Keep as is (the ex-HYDRA agents in episode 76 count as remnants acting)
Change step 13 status to Deceased (HYDRA itself does not return until episode 103)
owner_calls.evidence: Episode 76 'The Patriot': Mace's team crash-lands and finds 'ex-Hydra agents, hired by the Watchdogs'. Episode 103 'Rise and Shine' shows Hale's HYDRA revival. The returns are real; this is only how to label the gap.
